specsRaw.Solar-Powered Movement: This watch harnesses light to power its movement, eliminating the need for battery changes. The rechargeable battery lasts up to 8 months on a full charge, even in complete darkness.
specsRaw.Durable Design: Built with a 42.5mm brushed stainless steel case, this watch offers both strength and reliability. The black aluminum bezel rotates in one direction, while the sapphire glass resists scratches and ensures long-term durability.
specsRaw.Clear Readability: The blue dial includes luminous hour markers and hands for visibility in low light, with a red second hand for additional style.
specsRaw.Water Resistance: With a water resistance rating of up to 100 meters, this Swiss solar timepiece is perfect for both land and water activities.
specsRaw.Easy-Click System: Switch bands with ease using the easy-click system. This version comes with a stainless-steel bracelet, and you can purchase additional rubber bands separately to suit your personal style.
specsRaw.Swiss Craftsmanship: Built to the highest Swiss standards, this watch comes with a 2-year international warranty for peace of mind.
specsRaw.Extended Battery Life: A fully charged battery powers the watch for up to 8 months. For optimal performance, regularly expose the watch to light, ideally direct sunlight.
specsRaw.Quick Start Function: The watch resumes operation within minutes after exposure to sunlight, ensuring minimal downtime.
specsRaw.Battery Protection Mode: This feature prevents deep discharge by shutting off the movement when the battery is critically low, extending its lifespan.
specsRaw.Battery Overcharge Protection: Protects the battery from overcharging, ensuring optimal efficiency and longevity.
